title: Scaffold the pnpm workspace with four packages
description: Scaffold the pnpm workspace with four packages.
acceptance: Workspace has packages/authority, packages/client-sdk, packages/shared-crypto and packages/conformance under impl/core/amk-authority
No file outside impl/core/amk-authority and its own workflows is touched
No runtime dependencies beyond the platform and the declared tooling
findings: Imported plan placed packages at a monorepo root. They must live inside this directory because the repository root belongs to the Android app.
